messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident fired: INC-72345 — p99 latency SLO breach (api: /v1/generate) · observed p99 = 2.8s (>2.0s) for 6m · region=eu-west · impact: elevated tail latency, no 5xxs reported. https://pagerduty.local/incidents/INC-72345 :rotating_light:
Maya Li: acked on PagerDuty (INC-72345). I'm on it.
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-72345 acknowledged by Maya Li. Escalation policy: default-oncall -> senior-ml if not resolved in 15m.
Samir Patel: seeing the same on Grafana (eu-west). p95 ~ 900ms, p99 ~ 2.8s, request rate steady. Not a spike in qps. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.tools/d/latency-eu-west
Carla Nguyen: tagging runbook: docs/runbooks/latency-tail.md. Initial hunch: tokenizer mutex + long sequences causing serialization on hot path.
Emily R.: checking traces — a bunch of traces show spend in `tokenize()` (90-120ms each) but multiple calls pile up on same host. Looks like small batches, lots of short requests but single-threaded tokenizer worker saturated.
Maya Li: good catch. Can we route small requests to the lightweight tokenizer sidecar? Samir, can you check routing table for small-batch fastpath?
Samir Patel: running quick query: 
```
curl -s "https://api.redwood.internal/routing/fastpath?region=eu-west&size_lt=64" | jq .
```
Response: majority routed to inference-group-a (shared pool) — fastpath disabled for this customer cohort after last rollout.
Samir Patel: enabling fastpath rule for size < 64 now (temporary). Pushing rule patch: `rule.enable("fastpath-eu-small")`.
Carla Nguyen: I'm going to bump the tokenizer worker count on the sidecar in eu-west by +2 while we validate. Doing `kubectl scale deploy/tokenizer-sidecar -n inference --replicas=5`
incident-bot: Action logged: route rule update + tokenizer sidecar scale issued by Samir Patel and Carla Nguyen.
Emily R.: traces showing immediate improvement on a few requests — p95 down to ~450ms on those hosts. Still seeing high tail on a subset of hosts.
Maya Li: let's also enable fallback model variant with shorter decode path for the most latency-sensitive route to reduce tail while tokenizer warms. Samir — can you flip rollout to `model-small:v2` for route `realtime-eu`? Keep pinned to 10% then increase.
Samir Patel: starting canary: `deploy model-small:v2 -> realtime-eu (10%)` now. Logs: `canary started at 1789001260`
Emily R.: quick metric check: p99 (global) dropped to 1.9s after canary on a subset. eu-west p99 still ~2.2s overall.
Maya Li: good. I'll keep paging suppressed for autopager (15m) while we observe. We need a temp mitigation plan in case p99 creeps back: 1) expand fastpath rule 2) increase tokenizer replicas further 3) widen model-small canary 4) if regressions — rollback.
Carla Nguyen: agree. I'll prepare the rollback command and patch note in the runbook.
Samir Patel: scaling tokenizer further to 8 replicas now. Also nudged autoscaler min to 5 for the tokenizer deploy to avoid flapping.
Maya Li: customer impact check: Support instrumented a small sample set; none of the top-10 paying customers reported errors, but UI latency seen for chat widgets in eu-west (~2-3s delays). Tagging support for proactive messages.
Emily R.: capturing traces + sample request ids for postmortem. Example trace id: trace-0a1b2c3d. Storing to s3://redwood-ops/incidents/72345/traces.txt
pagerduty-bot: Note — escalation timer reset by acknowledgment. Next escalate in 15m if not resolved.
Samir Patel: widening canary to 40% now (keeping close watch). p99 eu-west at 1.4s on canary hosts, non-canary still ~2.1s.
Maya Li: can we also enable cache-prefetch (kv cache) for the tokenized prefixes for hot users? Might help the repeated short requests.
Carla Nguyen: prefetch toggle enabled for top-100 userkeys in eu-west. Monitoring effect.
Emily R.: metric snapshot after actions: p95=380ms, p99=1.7s (eu-west), errors 0.01% (unchanged). Looks trending down.
Maya Li: ok I'm going to mark incident as 'mitigated' but keep the PD incident open for followup. I'll hand off detailed postmortem to Night Oncall and Eng-ML.
Maya Li: <@Night Oncall> I need you to take the post-incident checklist: collect timeline, config diffs, and open followup ticket with runbook improvements. Assign to Eng-ML + DevEx.
Night Oncall: acknowledged. Will pick up at 2300 UTC and run through checklist.
Samir Patel: note for postmortem — recent rollout 1788998000 changed fastpath rule for a small cohort; candidate root cause: rollout unintentionally excluded small-batch fastpath in eu-west.
Carla Nguyen: saving commands executed and kubectl diffs to incident log.
Maya Li: thanks team. I'll update the PagerDuty incident notes and add mitigation steps. Please add any remaining notes to the thread.
Emily R.: adding top traces and metric graphs to the incident page.
Maya Li: last check before handoff: p99=1.5s eu-west, latency stabilized for 3m. Marking mitigated at 1789001302. Follow-up ticket: RED-INC-72345.
incident-bot: Incident INC-72345 status updated: MITIGATED (mitigated_by=Maya Li)"
